You will need to take them down in order to insure that they cannot get in your way.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" />}}
'''Seyda Shae''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Chirq Council]] [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" />

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Seyda Shae was a member of the [[Chirq Council]] in the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. She worked alongside [[Human/Legends|Human]] adjutant [[Genovin Jasha]].<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] decided to infiltrate the organization with a CorSec agent using the identity of one of the Chirq Council members: [[Trins Evnar]]. After killing him, the agent also eliminated every Chirq Council criminals who used to know Evnar in order to permit the infiltration mission. The agent thus killed [[Jade McDonagh]] and [[Kazic Pendre]], as well as Seyda Shae and Genovin Jasha in a small camp outside Doaba Guerfel.<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> The spacer later assumed Trins Evnar's identity towards the underboss [[Jzoro Quanera]] and managed to infiltrate the organization.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "The Chirq Council: Moving Up" on Corellia</ref> The CorSec operation eventually led to the destruction of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Seyda Shae was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Seyda Shae was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
